source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Proposal for the auto-tree drag fixture: keep a workaround comment tied to the concrete synthesized action and the linked issue. The historical label repeats Colour so the header-cell centre contains text; the comment says only header text can be dragged and links Bug 1908314. This is deliberate fixture geometry, not a production label or a naming convention. The fixed fixture no longer repeats the label, and its retained drag helper computes actual header-button centres and starts/ends a test drag session. Read that current path before copying the workaround. No widget drag, linked bug or accessibility test was run.
title: Explain the drag fixture target and workaround scope
